gemma3_4b_ollama_safe.name: gemma3_4b_ollama_safe
gemma3_4b_ollama_safe.description: Ollama Gemma 3 4B safe default profile for local multimodal use.
gemma3_4b_ollama_safe.notes: Stable default for local testing. Use this first unless a larger local profile is clearly better.

gemma3_12b_ollama_safe.name: gemma3_12b_ollama_safe
gemma3_12b_ollama_safe.description: Ollama Gemma 3 12B with conservative limits for 8 GB VRAM. Expect partial CPU offload on many 8 GB systems.
gemma3_12b_ollama_safe.notes: Larger local Ollama profile. Test carefully because it is slower and more memory constrained than 4B.

gemma3_12b_gguf_q4_safe.name: gemma3_12b_gguf_q4_safe
gemma3_12b_gguf_q4_safe.description: llama.cpp GGUF Q4_K_M Gemma 3 12B profile with q8_0 KV cache.
gemma3_12b_gguf_q4_safe.notes: Preferred local llama.cpp text profile. Use an Ollama/Qwen fallback for vision tasks. q8_0 KV halves attention memory.

qwen3vl_8b_ollama.name: qwen3vl_8b_ollama
qwen3vl_8b_ollama.description: Qwen3-VL 8B instruct profile for local image, OCR, and text tasks.
qwen3vl_8b_ollama.notes: Pull with: ollama pull qwen3-vl:8b-instruct. Compare it with the 4B profile if memory or latency is tight.

qwen3vl_4b_ollama.name: qwen3vl_4b_ollama
qwen3vl_4b_ollama.description: Qwen3-VL 4B instruct - fast vision model for OCR and UI screenshots.
qwen3vl_4b_ollama.notes: Pull with: ollama pull qwen3-vl:4b-instruct. Uses less memory than the 8B profile and is useful for faster image tasks.

qwen25_coder_7b_ollama.name: qwen25_coder_7b_ollama
qwen25_coder_7b_ollama.description: Qwen2.5-Coder 7B profile for code generation and editing tasks.
qwen25_coder_7b_ollama.notes: Pull with: ollama pull qwen2.5-coder:7b. Benchmark it with your own languages and repository prompts.

qwen3_8b_ollama.name: qwen3_8b_ollama
qwen3_8b_ollama.description: Qwen3 8B general text and structured-output profile for 8 GB VRAM.
qwen3_8b_ollama.notes: Pull with: ollama pull qwen3:8b. This profile disables thinking output so clients receive a normal content field.

llama31_8b_ollama.name: llama31_8b_ollama
llama31_8b_ollama.description: Llama 3.1 8B general text profile with conservative local limits.
llama31_8b_ollama.notes: Pull with: ollama pull llama3.1:8b. Llama 3.3 is a 70B model, so use the 3.1 tag when you need an 8B Llama profile.

phi4_mini_ollama.name: phi4_mini_ollama
phi4_mini_ollama.description: Phi-4-mini 3.8B compact profile for low-memory and latency-sensitive tasks.
phi4_mini_ollama.notes: Pull with: ollama pull phi4-mini. Its smaller size leaves more memory headroom than the 7B and 8B profiles.

deepseek_r1_distill_qwen_7b_ollama.name: deepseek_r1_distill_qwen_7b_ollama
deepseek_r1_distill_qwen_7b_ollama.description: DeepSeek-R1-Distill Qwen 7B - local chain-of-thought reasoning model.
deepseek_r1_distill_qwen_7b_ollama.notes: Pull with: ollama pull deepseek-r1:7b. Emits visible <think> reasoning tokens; raise max_output_tokens for long chains.

mistral_7b_ollama.name: mistral_7b_ollama
mistral_7b_ollama.description: Mistral 7B v0.3 general text profile for mid-range hardware.
mistral_7b_ollama.notes: Pull with: ollama pull mistral:7b. Speed-bound chat default. (Mistral Small 3 is 24B and does not fit.)

qwen3_8b_gguf_q4km_kvq8.name: qwen3_8b_gguf_q4km_kvq8
qwen3_8b_gguf_q4km_kvq8.description: Qwen3 8B Q4_K_M llama.cpp profile with a q8_0 KV cache for 8 GB VRAM.
qwen3_8b_gguf_q4km_kvq8.notes: Download a bartowski Q4_K_M GGUF of Qwen3-8B-Instruct and update model_id. q8_0 KV halves attention memory.

d1_omni_600m_decision.name: d1_omni_600m_decision
d1_omni_600m_decision.description: LiquidAI d1-omni-600M decision model (587M). Typed answers with probabilities in one pass; fits the CPU.
d1_omni_600m_decision.notes: Runs the model's own code (trust_remote_code), so keep revision pinned. LFM Open License v1.0: free for commercial use below US$10M annual revenue; set license_accepted to true once you have read it. Needs requirements-decision.txt.

d1_3b_decision.name: d1_3b_decision
d1_3b_decision.description: LiquidAI d1-3B decision model (3.1B). Strongest d1; wants a GPU with about 7 GB free.
d1_3b_decision.notes: Same terms as d1-omni-600M. Use device cuda with bfloat16, or cpu (slow). Needs requirements-decision.txt.

laya_decision.name: laya_decision
laya_decision.description: Laya English checkpoint (421M, Apache-2.0). A fast base that is best fine-tuned on your own decisions.
laya_decision.notes: Laya's own card calls the base checkpoint 'a fast base to specialise, not a zero-shot decision engine'. Needs requirements-decision.txt.

laya_typed_decision.name: laya_typed_decision
laya_typed_decision.description: Laya typed-decisions checkpoint (421M, Apache-2.0), fine-tuned for workflow decisions.
laya_typed_decision.notes: Larger context (1024 tokens) than the base checkpoint. Needs requirements-decision.txt.

systemone_http_decision.name: systemone_http_decision
systemone_http_decision.description: Forward to any other server on this machine that already serves /v1/systemone.
systemone_http_decision.notes: For example laya-serve, ollaya or Kev. Loopback only. No extra packages needed.

d3_lite_decision.name: d3_lite_decision
d3_lite_decision.description: vLLM Semantic Router d3-lite (0.85B, Apache-2.0) in llama.cpp. The recommended CPU decision model.
d3_lite_decision.notes: Needs llama.cpp b11976 or newer (winget install ggml.llamacpp, brew install llama.cpp, or a release); LocalDeploy finds llama-server on PATH, in a WinGet install, or at LLAMACPP_SERVER_PATH. First use downloads the BF16 file (about 1.7 GB) and makes a Q4_K_M file once (about 0.5 GB), which answered in about 0.5 s on 8 CPU threads. To skip that step use model_id ggml-org/vllm-d3-lite-GGUF:Q8_0 without quantize (about 1.8x slower).

d3_nano_decision.name: d3_nano_decision
d3_nano_decision.description: vLLM Semantic Router d3-nano (2.2B, Apache-2.0) in llama.cpp. As accurate as d3-lite, steadier on follow-up messages, about 4x slower.
d3_nano_decision.notes: First use downloads the BF16 file (about 4.4 GB) and makes a Q4_K_M file once, which answered in about 2 s on 8 CPU threads (Q8_0, without quantize, takes about 5 s).

d3_mini_decision.name: d3_mini_decision
d3_mini_decision.description: vLLM Semantic Router d3-mini (4.5B, Apache-2.0) in llama.cpp. The largest d3 that fits an 8 GB GPU; too slow for a CPU.
d3_mini_decision.notes: Built for a GPU with about 4 GB free; on a CPU it takes many seconds per decision.

d1_3b_gguf_decision.name: d1_3b_gguf_decision
d1_3b_gguf_decision.description: LiquidAI d1-3B (3.1B) in llama.cpp, Q4_K_M. Very well calibrated; about 2.8 s on a CPU.
d1_3b_gguf_decision.notes: LFM Open License v1.0: free for commercial use below US$10M annual revenue; set license_accepted once you have read it. A GGUF needs no trust_remote_code.

qwen35_9b_llamacpp.name: qwen35_9b_llamacpp
qwen35_9b_llamacpp.description: llama.cpp Qwen3.5 9B Q4_K_M for agent work: the best of the small Qwen models in the agent-operator benchmark.
qwen35_9b_llamacpp.notes: Thinking is off (--reasoning off): with it on the 9B was 4x slower and scored lower. gpu_layers is left unset so llama-server's --fit fills the GPU. About 5.6 GB of VRAM at 16K context. See benchmarks/agent-operator.

qwen3vl_8b_llamacpp.name: qwen3vl_8b_llamacpp
qwen3vl_8b_llamacpp.description: llama.cpp Qwen3-VL 8B Q4_K_M: the same model as qwen3vl_8b_ollama, run directly.
qwen3vl_8b_llamacpp.notes: Same model and answers as the Ollama profile at about a fifth of the time per agent step in the benchmark (2.8 s against 13.4 s median). Text only as configured: for images add --mmproj and the projector file to server_args.
